newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine July inflation seen at 0.1 pct-c.bank.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine July inflation seen at 0.1 pct-c.bank.

text.p: Ukraine's July inflation rate will be less than 0.1 percent, and prices could even fall, National Bank of Ukraine head Viktor Yushchenko said on Friday.
"It seems that we can talk about a level of inflation of 0.1 percent or tiny deflation," Yushchenko told reporters.
Last month, inflation stood at 0.1 percent. January posted the highest inflation level this year at 2.2 percent.
The government forecasts inflation for the year between 15 and 16 percent compared to 39.7 percent in 1996.
